strategy.thesis: The venture capital arm of Samsung Group, established in 1999 to consolidate the group's venture investments. Invests globally in early- and growth-stage companies aligned with Samsung's strategic technology interests: semiconductors, AI, robotics, AR/VR, next-gen displays, battery tech, 5G, digital health and life sciences.

application.how_to_apply: Startup inquiries via regional offices; contact email sv.a@samsung.com for US.

summary.en: Samsung Group's corporate venture capital arm, founded in 1999 and headquartered in Seoul, with offices across the US, Israel, Europe, India, China and Japan. One of the most active corporate VCs globally, with roughly $2.8B in assets under management, focused on semiconductors, AI, robotics, displays, health and frontier hardware aligned with Samsung's businesses.
summary.local: 삼성그룹의 기업주도형 벤처캐피탈로 1999년 설립되어 서울에 본사를 두고 있으며, 반도체·AI·로봇·디스플레이 등 삼성 사업과 연계된 분야에 글로벌 투자를 진행한다.

strategy.thesis: Corporate venture arm of LG, founded in 2018 and based in Silicon Valley, funded by LG affiliates (LG Electronics, LG Energy Solution, LG Chem, LG Uplus, LG CNS, etc.). Invests in AI, biotech, cleantech, mobility, advanced materials and next-gen display/5G, giving portfolio companies access to LG's global network.

summary.en: LG's Silicon Valley-based corporate venture capital arm, founded in 2018 with nearly $1bn under management funded by multiple LG affiliates. Invests in AI, biotech, cleantech, mobility and advanced materials; notable bets include Anthropic and Figure AI.

strategy.thesis: Kakao Corp's early-stage venture arm (formerly K Cube Ventures, founded 2012, acquired by Kakao in 2015). One of Korea's most active seed-stage investors, backing deep tech, ICT services, digital healthcare and gaming startups; positions itself as a 'co-pilot' to founders.

application.how_to_apply: Inbound via website; very active seed-stage inbound.

summary.en: Kakao's corporate venture arm and one of Korea's most active seed-stage VCs. Originally K Cube Ventures (2012), acquired by Kakao in 2015. Manages over $300M (KRW 430B+) across 11+ funds and has backed 280+ companies in deep tech, software, digital health and gaming.

strategy.thesis: Naver Corp's corporate venture / accelerator arm, founded in 2015, investing at the idea-to-Series-A stage in tech startups (AI, robotics, autonomous driving, healthcare, AR/VR, IoT). Connects portfolio companies to Naver's technology and business organizations; expanding to Silicon Valley to support global scaling.

program.location: Seongnam / Seoul, with Silicon Valley base
program.eligibility: Early-stage tech startups, often developer-driven teams.

summary.en: Naver's corporate venture and accelerator arm (founded 2015), an early-stage investor in Korean tech startups across AI, robotics, mobility and healthcare. Backed 115+ startups including AI-chip maker FuriosaAI; its portfolio's combined value has been reported above $2B. Expanding to Silicon Valley to support founders' global growth.
summary.local: 네이버의 기업주도형 벤처캐피탈 겸 액셀러레이터(2015년 설립). AI·로봇·모빌리티·헬스케어 초기 기술 스타트업 115개 이상에 투자했으며, 대표 포트폴리오로 AI 반도체 기업 퓨리오사AI가 있다.

name.en: SK Telecom Venture Capital (SK Telecom Ventures)

strategy.thesis: Silicon Valley-based corporate venture capital arm of SK Telecom, South Korea's largest telecom operator. Makes strategic early-to-mid-stage investments in mobile platforms and infrastructure, semiconductors, and enterprise solutions (computing, storage, networking).

summary.en: Silicon Valley-based corporate venture capital arm of SK Telecom, Korea's largest mobile operator. Invests strategically in mobile/infrastructure, semiconductors and enterprise solutions; reported 45 investments and 11 exits. SK Telecom itself has also taken strategic AI stakes (Anthropic, Perplexity).

name.en: Hyundai Motor Group ZER01NE (incl. Hyundai CRADLE)

strategy.thesis: Hyundai Motor Group's open-innovation and corporate venture platform (launched 2018), combining CVC and open innovation. Comprises ZER01NE Company Builder, Accelerator, Fund, and the global Hyundai CRADLE network. Invests in AI, robotics, cybersecurity, hydrogen/energy and future mobility startups aligned with the group's strategy.

program.location: Seoul, with CRADLE hubs in Silicon Valley, Tel Aviv, Berlin, Beijing, Singapore
program.eligibility: Early-stage startups in AI, robotics, mobility, energy and related future-tech areas.

application.how_to_apply: Apply via ZER01NE open calls at zer01ne.zone.

summary.en: Hyundai Motor Group's corporate venture and open-innovation platform launched in 2018, spanning ZER01NE (company builder, accelerator, fund) and the global Hyundai CRADLE network (Silicon Valley, Tel Aviv, Berlin, Beijing, Singapore). Has invested in 109 startups; latest ZER01NE Fund III is KRW 125B (~$91M), backed by 10 group affiliates, targeting AI, robotics, cybersecurity and hydrogen/energy.
summary.local: 현대자동차그룹의 기업주도형 벤처캐피탈 겸 오픈이노베이션 플랫폼(2018년 출범). ZER01NE(컴퍼니빌더·액셀러레이터·펀드)과 글로벌 CRADLE 네트워크로 구성되며, 109개 스타트업에 투자했고 ZER01NE Fund III는 1,250억원 규모다.
